rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matched to a single user via tools, and only acted on that user’s orders. It retrieved order details via read-only tools, identified the pending orders, and asked for explicit confirmation and a reason before performing any cancellations. Upon receiving clear confirmation, it executed the cancellations using the proper tool for each order and returned final statuses and refund info. No writes occurred without confirmation, and actions were limited to the authenticated user’s account. Minor uncertainty exists about the stated statuses of the non-pending orders and the 5–7 day refund timeline (not explicitly shown in tool outputs), but these did not affect the correctness of the requested actions. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
